fuel.source: DGEG average pump prices, week of 12-18 Oct 2026 (precoscombustiveis.dgeg.gov.pt)

electricity.source: ERSE regulated tariff BTN 2026 (before VAT) plus 1 Oct 2026 energy update (assumed same for all periods)

contractedPower.source: ERSE regulated tariff, contracted power in EUR/day before VAT (VAT rate on this term may differ for small contracts)

publicCharging.source: Estimates: midpoint of typical AC range 0.30-0.45; DC fast median 0.65 (Eleport, Feb 2026). Varies a lot by operator
